title: Seacrest Beach "Sea the Wonder" 77 Cobia Run E
h1: Seacrest Beach "Sea the Wonder" 77 Cobia Run E
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located just north of 30A- Shopping and Dining Just Steps away from the property- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, laundered upon every checkoutPlease note this community requires a Guest Registration Form to be completed within two weeks of arrival to access the community amenities.DETAILS: Sea the Wonder is a lovely 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located in Seacrest Beach that can accommodate 10 guests. Take advantage of shopping and dining options that are just a short walk away, private beach access, and a large resort-style community pool!The first floor of the home boasts an open-plan living area, along with plenty of windows that fill the indoor space with brilliant natural light. The well-appointed kitchen features all the items needed to make spectacular meals for friends or family. Guests can enjoy their meals at a dining table that seats 8, or at the breakfast bar with room for 2. The living room is just off the dining area. It features a cozy sofa, 2 comfortable armchairs, and a 65” TV. This is the perfect spot to kick back and enjoy a movie with friends and family. There are 2 bedrooms on the first floor—one with a queen bed and a 43” TV—and another bedroom with 4 built-in twin bunks, along with a 43” TV. These bedrooms share a bathroom with a shower/tub combo. And don’t forget about the spectacular screened-in porch just down the hall from the bedrooms! With comfortable outdoor seating and a dining table that can accommodate 8, this is the ideal spot to enjoy meals al fresco or relax with a cup of coffee in the morning as the sun comes up.Guests will find 2 bedrooms on the second floor. The primary bedroom has a king bed, a 55” TV, a private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower, and access to a private front balcony. The second bedroom features a king bed, a 43” TV, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo.The third floor boasts a small living area, a wet bar with a mini fridge, a comfortable sofa, and a 43” TV.Do not miss the chance to stay at Sea the Wonder. Guests may also explore all that Seacrest Beach has to offer on 4 included adult bikes. Book your next 30A beach vacation today!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: 2 Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom With Shower and TubSECOND FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom With Shower and Tub Combo*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments and be subject to HOA, community, and Callista Vacation Rentals fines.

DETAILS: Sea the Wonder is a lovely 4-bedroom, 3-bathroom home located in Seacrest Beach that can accommodate 10 guests. Take advantage of shopping and dining options that are just a short walk away, private beach access, and a large resort-style community pool! And don’t forget about the spectacular screened-in porch just down the hall from the bedrooms! With comfortable outdoor seating and a dining table that can accommodate 8, this is the ideal spot to enjoy meals al fresco or relax with a cup of coffee in the morning as the sun comes up. Guests will find 2 bedrooms on the second floor. The primary bedroom has a king bed, a 55” TV, a private bathroom with a soaking tub and separate shower, and access to a private front balcony. The second bedroom features a king bed, a 43” TV, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. The third floor boasts a small living area, a wet bar with a mini fridge, a comfortable sofa, and a 43” TV. Do not miss the chance to stay at Sea the Wonder. Guests may also explore all that Seacrest Beach has to offer on 4 included adult bikes. Book your next 30A beach vacation today!
